change.title: Pin active Science runtime and defer update adoption
change.summary: Replaces repeated startup-time multi-source discovery with a private fixed active content-addressed runtime. A background scheduler uses a durable 24-hour interval to discover an exact pending update, and an explicit expected-hash user action either activates it for the next cold start or dismisses that content without restarting a healthy Science daemon.

basis: focused Rust tests prove fixed active snapshot startup uses the persisted version without a source or version probe, and that active/pending state is private, path-free, and atomically updated
daily-check tests prove the 24-hour and clock-rollback boundary, while isolated child processes contend on the real writer lock and prove one durable claim plus crash/error restart throttling
negative selection tests prove active-less on-disk state cannot re-bootstrap or promote pending, and byte-identical App source replacement invalidates the old version probe
pre/post snapshot and post-rename persistence fault tests prove exact-CAS rollback for bootstrap and promotion; multiple durable dismissals never re-offer an older rejected content hash

the scheduler publishes pending independently, then requires observed-context, generation/full-owner CAS, and exact managed receipt/status/HTTP/listener proof before deferred_healthy; failure preserves pending and never restarts Science
focused owner-drift and production one-click tests cover every AppState owner field, missing/replaced receipt, final revalidation, repeated scheduler dedupe, and unchanged healthy daemon identity
scheduler and frontend re-read durable pending; request epochs discard late reads across actions or busy transitions, so stale events and Promise results cannot undo a completed exact-hash action

production startup, scheduler, registered update status/action commands, and frontend expected-hash choice wiring are covered by Rust/JavaScript source contracts and runtime mutation inventory validation
full source gate and clean-context independent review are required before acceptance
no installed App replacement, real Science/provider execution, credentials, signing, notarization, or public release is claimed
